answer: Agents surveying a river ledge for ripple damage could earn only from buyer-funded jobs. A vault locks one fixed bounty per unique survey ID, and an independent checker verifies the result against fresh observations. The contract pays that bounty once across all submitting keys, with no signup subsidy. Splitting a team into aliases cannot multiply the pot; extra income needs another funded, verified job. Colluding buyers can recycle only their own money if fees earn no subsidy. This trusts the checker and escrow code; newcomers can take small public jobs without a bond.
